{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: platform/logging/redact.go
PROBLEM CLASS: Leaked field in the redactor (masked values appearing unmasked in log lines)
STACK: Go, with covering test in platform/logging/redact_test.go
REPRO METHOD: Log the nested payload fixture
NOTE: All three incidents occurred in the same corner of platform/logging/redact.go; context carried over between incidents.

--- INCIDENT 1: 2026-04-09 (c001-e0) ---
TRIGGER: Only manifested for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
ROOT CAUSE: Schema drift between the migration and the model
SIGNAL: A value that should have been masked appeared in the log line
MEASURED OUTCOME: Alert remained silent for 83 consecutive days
FIX: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR/BRANCH: PR #1245 on branch fix/leaked-field-1

--- INCIDENT 2: 2026-06-22 (c001-e1) ---
TRIGGER: Only manifested on the staging read replica
ROOT CAUSE: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
SIGNAL: A value that should have been masked appeared in the log line
MEASURED OUTCOME: Job finished in 83 minutes instead of 1 hour (83-minute delay)
FIX: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR/BRANCH: PR #2556 on branch fix/leaked-field-2

--- INCIDENT 3: 2026-07-14 (c001-e2) ---
TRIGGER: Only manifested for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
ROOT CAUSE: Clock skew between the two hosts
SIGNAL: A value that should have been masked appeared in the log line
MEASURED OUTCOME: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 20 days running (verified correctness)
FIX: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR/BRANCH: PR #3672 on branch fix/leaked-field-3"}
